Name: /dev/null
Tagline: a social network for devs
Topics: Open Source, Social Network, Software Engineering, GitHub
Description: /dev/null started as a live stream from the JetBrains office. On Oct 15, 2026, Nuno Maduro, Brent Roose, Matthieu Napoli, and Pauline Vos built a social network for web developers from scratch in 48 hours, in the open. Sign in with GitHub, share code snippets, like, reply, etc, etc! Hundreds of you sent PRs. Laravel’s Taylor Otwell stopped by mid-stream (“Laravel forever”), and Vercel’s Guillermo Rauch called it “really well done.” Thank you for watching, sharing, and roasting us.

Name: Harness²
Tagline: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement.
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

Name: Composio Instant
Tagline: The easiest way for AI agents to pay for their own tools
Description: Give your agent superpowers. No subscriptions, no signups. With Composio Instant, your agent can search the web, find business contacts, create voiceovers, turn audio into text, and so much more. Try it free: composio.dev/instant

Name: ESP-Mosaico
Tagline: A modular development board built for agents
Description: Built for Coding Agents, ESP-Mosaico is a modular development board powered by ESP32-S31. It takes AI agents beyond software and into the physical world, enabling them to create, deploy, test, and iterate on real hardware. Expandable modules and multi-unit tiling give AI agents more ways to create, while Chat Coding and Vibe Coding give you intuitive ways to turn ideas into working physical devices.

Name: RunInfra
Tagline: Open models, built for agents.
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: RunInfra Coding Plans give your coding agent fast open models for a flat monthly price, starting at $10. Use GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and more inside Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build. Setup takes one prompt: paste it into your agent, approve sign-in, done. Session-aware routing hits cache up to 99.5% of the time, so your plan goes further. Zero data retention, no training on prompts, SOC 2 Type II.

Name: bonds
Tagline: Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers
Description: bonds is the messaging app for the next generation. Every friends' chat gets an AI friend with superpowers. Not an assistant: it gets your inside jokes, keeps the fun going, helps you pull things off together. A little unhinged 💀 "A week without TikTok?" It creates a challenge app with streaks, inside the chat. No downloads. Games, videos, stickers, too. It remembers what matters to each of you, notices when someone's struggling, gets grumpy if you ghost it. You care for it, it cares for you.

Name: Mintlify Autopilot
Tagline: An always-on agent that keeps your docs up to date
Description: Autopilot is an always-on docs agent from Mintlify. It watches your code and tools like Slack, drafts doc updates when something changes, and opens a pull request for your team to review. It learns your style from every PR you merge or close.

Name: Exa 3.0
Tagline: Smarter search that gives AI agent richer data at lower cost
Description: Exa 3.0 is the biggest search quality update to Exa’s search API for AI agents. It adds a larger embedding model, billions of new documents including 1.27B ecommerce listings and 211M+ local businesses, and Dynamic Highlights, which use 95% fewer tokens than full page text. A new Exa Lite tier costs $4 per 1,000 requests, and Exa Auto costs $7. Available now through the API.

Name: Asimov 1
Tagline: The most customizable humanoid robot you can buy
Description: Asimov 1 is a humanoid robot you can build a company on. Our own enterprise deployments are built on it. Train it and shape it for whatever you’re building. Bought by founders, researchers and developers in 20+ countries.

Name: xtty
Tagline: A terminal that makes everyday work easier.
Description: Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

Name: Jotform App Builder for ChatGPT & Claude
Tagline: Build and edit no-code apps inside ChatGPT & Claude
Description: Tell ChatGPT or Claude what kind of app you need, and build it with Jotform App Builder. Create a customer portal, employee hub, event app, or product catalog that brings your forms, documents, and links together. Ask for changes to the content, layout, or branding, then share the app with customers or your team. Build on your existing Jotform forms for collecting responses, accepting payments, and gathering signed documents. No coding required.

Name: reception
Tagline: Native iOS support chat for less churn
Description: The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.

Name: Intel® GPU D-series
Tagline: Memory-rich AI inference without HBM
Description: Intel GPU D270 is an inference-optimized data center GPU built for agentic AI, long contexts, and high-concurrency serving at practical power and cost.

Name: Kling 4.0
Tagline: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators
Description: Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

Name: Hoistbay
Tagline: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront
Description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

Name: Portlivo
Tagline: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Portlivo shows every dev server and port running on your Mac: which project it's from, the command, uptime and whether it's answering. Open, restart, kill, tail logs or share any of them in one click. Native, no account, one-time price.

Name: yggy
Tagline: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself
Description: Most "chat with your data" tools throw a pile of text chunks at a model and hope for the best. yggy does what they skip: it turns your cluttered documents and connected systems into a real knowledge graph, with no schema to design and no pipeline to run. Every fact keeps its source. Duplicates merge themselves, and you can undo any merge. Then one graph serves everyone: your team in the app, your code through the API, your agents through MCP. Hosted in the EU. Your knowledge stays yours.

Name: Praex
Tagline: The coding agent that runs on its own AI models
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

Name: ToDo.is
Tagline: Write a to-do and your AI agent gets it done
Topics: Android, Chrome Extensions, Productivity, Task Management, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Todo.is is an always-on AI agent you give to-dos to. Write "find a cheaper flight to Lisbon" or "turn this PDF into Word" and it does the work: researches with sources, makes files and images, uses websites, and reports back on the web, Android, WhatsApp or Telegram. It runs 24/7 in its own sandbox, remembers you, does daily briefings and price alerts on a schedule, can work in your own Chrome, and asks before it pays, sends or deletes anything. Try it for $1.

Name: Inflight
Tagline: Capture design feedback directly inside your prototypes
Description: Inflight puts a feedback toolkit on your preview links and HTML prototypes. Reviewers comment directly on the live running app, with comments pinned to real elements, and feedback becomes next steps a coding agent can implement over MCP.
